name: SkyPort
summary:
SkyPort brings the screens of your own computers into your Meta Quest 3 or 3S. Put your Mac next to your PCs, with every screen live at the same time.

HOW IT WORKS
- Install the free SkyPort Agent on each Mac or Windows PC, from skyportvr.com.
- In SkyPort, open the menu, choose Scan QR code, and look at the code the agent shows. Click Allow on the computer to pair.
- Your chosen displays appear as screens in front of you. Next time, SkyPort reconnects on its own.
